card.text: M13 is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 7,420 parsecs away.

sources.quote: Messier 13, or M13, is a globular cluster of several hundred thousand stars in the constellation of Hercules.

introduction.text: M13 is drawn as 5,974 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
